<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

HCCL buffer sizes need manual tuning for each model and prefill workload. Size unset buffers automatically during NPU startup, before workers create communication groups, while preserving existing environment overrides.

## Modifications

- Estimate `HCCL_BUFFSIZE` from representative prefill rows, hidden size and dtype, with 1.25× headroom, 32 MiB rounding and a 64–1024 MiB range.
- Estimate `DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE` using the normal-mode dispatch/combine formula only for MoE models using the `deepep` backend, EP > 1 and `normal` or `auto` mode. Preserve existing round and streaming settings and validate their bounds.
- Round the DeepEP requirement up to 32 MiB and raise an actionable startup error above the 4096 MiB automatic limit. Never silently clamp below the calculated requirement.
- Preserve explicit buffer values and the existing DeepEP-to-HCCL fallback precedence. Explicit overrides bypass unnecessary calculations; validate all proposed sizes before changing the environment.
- Enable sizing by default without adding environment controls. Log sizing decisions and document legacy overrides, MiB units and communication-group memory implications.

## Accuracy Tests

At `77fcbab3d9`, the focused CPU suite passed **16 tests and 33 subtests**:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/npu/test_npu_autotune.py
```

Coverage includes formulas, rounding and overflow, explicit override precedence, backend/mode applicability, transport settings, dtype payloads, startup ordering, worker environment inheritance and unchanged environment on calculation failure. Scoped Ruff lint/format checks and `git diff --check` passed.

These checks validate the policy and startup hook on the host. Target NPU startup, HCCL communication, model accuracy and memory use remain unverified.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No target NPU performance measurements are available. Throughput, latency and peak HBM use need comparison against explicit buffer settings under the same model, topology and workload.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -0,0 +1,242 @@
+"""Default deterministic NPU HCCL buffer sizing; importing never initializes a device.
+
+References:
+- CANN 9.1 (sglang NPU default) HCCL_BUFFSIZE: default 200 MB when unset, must
+  be positive, and every communication domain allocates send + receive buffers
+  (~2x the value).
+  https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/en/canncommercial/910/maintenref/envvar/envref_07_0080.html
+- torch_npu reads HCCL_BUFFSIZE in OptionsManager.cpp (default 200, > 0) and
+  per-group hccl_buffer_size pg options override it.
+- DeepEP Ascend buffer formulas (sglang expert_parallelism docs); the fixed
+  102 MB + 4 MB window offsets and the 2x send/receive factor are identical
+  across A2 (910B), A3 and Ascend 950 in the sgl-kernel-npu tilings:
+    combine streaming on:  2 * (106MB + PER_ROUND_TOKENS * 3 * hidden * topk) + PADDING
+    combine streaming off: 2 * (106MB + TOTAL_SEQ_LEN * 2 * hidden * topk) + PADDING
+  where PER_ROUND_TOKENS is DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_PER_ROUND_TOKENS (default
+  8192), combine streaming is DEEPEP_NORMAL_COMBINE_ENABLE_LONG_SEQ (default
+  off), and dispatch/combine rounds carry three resp. two hidden-sized tensors
+  per selected expert.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import math
+import os
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+MIB = 1 << 20
+# DeepEP Ascend fixed per-direction overhead: 102 MB framework + 4 MB metadata,
+# and the documented PADDING_BUFFSIZE recommendation is 20 MB.
+DEEPEP_FIXED_OVERHEAD_MB = 106
+DEEPEP_PADDING_MB = 20
+DEEPEP_MIN_BUFFSIZE_MB = 2 * DEEPEP_FIXED_OVERHEAD_MB + DEEPEP_PADDING_MB
+# Default of DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_PER_ROUND_TOKENS; valid range [32, 8192].
+DEEPEP_PER_ROUND_TOKENS = 8192
+DEEPEP_MAX_BUFFSIZE_MB = 4096
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class NpuTuningContext:
+    """Model and parallelism facts that determine representative HCCL sizes."""
+
+    hidden_size: int
+    num_experts_per_tok: int | None
+    tp_size: int
+    ep_size: int
+    chunked_prefill_size: int
+    max_prefill_tokens: int
+    dtype: str
+
+
+def representative_prefill_rows(context: NpuTuningContext) -> int:
+    if context.max_prefill_tokens <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("max_prefill_tokens must be positive for NPU autotuning")
+    if context.chunked_prefill_size > 0:
+        return min(context.chunked_prefill_size, context.max_prefill_tokens)
+    return context.max_prefill_tokens
+
+
+def _quantize_mb(raw_mb, quantum_mb, min_mb, max_mb):
+    if min(quantum_mb, min_mb) <= 0 or max_mb < min_mb:
+        raise ValueError("rounding quantum and bounds must be positive")
+    return min(max_mb, max(min_mb, math.ceil(raw_mb / quantum_mb) * quantum_mb))
+
+
+def hccl_buffer_mb(
+    token_rows,
+    hidden_size,
+    element_size,
+    headroom=1.25,
+    quantum_mb=32,
+    min_mb=64,
+    max_mb=1024,
+):
+    """Size one collective payload: rows * hidden * element bytes plus headroom."""
+    if min(token_rows, hidden_size, element_size) <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("HCCL dimensions must be positive")
+    if not math.isfinite(headroom) or headroom < 1:
+        raise ValueError("HCCL headroom must be a multiplier >= 1")
+    raw = token_rows * hidden_size * element_size * headroom / MIB
+    return _quantize_mb(raw, quantum_mb, min_mb, max_mb)
+
+
+def deepep_normal_buffer_mb(
+    token_rows,
+    hidden_size,
+    topk,
+    per_round_tokens=DEEPEP_PER_ROUND_TOKENS,
+    ant_moving=False,
+    combine_long_seq=False,
+    quantum_mb=32,
+    min_mb=DEEPEP_MIN_BUFFSIZE_MB,
+    max_mb=DEEPEP_MAX_BUFFSIZE_MB,
+):
+    """Size the DeepEP Ascend normal-mode buffer from the documented formulas.
+
+    With combine streaming on, rounds carry three hidden-sized tensors per
+    expert (dispatch plus double-buffered combine); with it off (default), the
+    full sequence must fit with two tensors per expert. The 2x covers
+    send + receive.
+    """
+    if min(token_rows, hidden_size, topk, per_round_tokens) <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("DeepEP dimensions must be positive")
+    per_round = min(token_rows, per_round_tokens) * 3 * hidden_size * topk
+    full_seq = token_rows * 2 * hidden_size * topk
+    if combine_long_seq:
+        payload = per_round
+    elif ant_moving:
+        payload = max(full_seq, per_round)
+    else:
+        payload = full_seq
+    raw = 2 * (DEEPEP_FIXED_OVERHEAD_MB + payload / MIB) + DEEPEP_PADDING_MB
+    if min(quantum_mb, min_mb) <= 0 or max_mb < min_mb:
+        raise ValueError("rounding quantum and bounds must be positive")
+    required = math.ceil(max(raw, min_mb) / quantum_mb) * quantum_mb
+    details = (
+        f"rows={token_rows} hidden={hidden_size} topk={topk} "
+        f"per_round_tokens={per_round_tokens} ant_moving={ant_moving} "
+        f"combine_long_seq={combine_long_seq} raw_MiB={raw:g} "
+        f"required_MiB={required} cap_MiB={max_mb}"
+    )
+    if required > max_mb:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Automatic DeepEP HCCL sizing exceeds its limit: {details}. "
+            "Set DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE explicitly or reduce the workload."
+        )
+    logger.info("NPU autotune: DeepEP normal-mode requirement %s", details)
+    return required
+
+
+def context_from_server_args(server_args):
+    from sglang.srt.arg_groups.model_override_base import model_config_of
+
+    model = model_config_of(server_args)
+    hf = model.hf_text_config
+    return NpuTuningContext(
+        hf.hidden_size,
+        getattr(hf, "num_experts_per_tok", None),
+        server_args.tp_size,
+        server_args.ep_size,
+        server_args.chunked_prefill_size,
+        server_args.max_prefill_tokens,
+        str(model.dtype),
+    )
+
+
+def _deepep_round_config():
+    tokens_name = "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_PER_ROUND_TOKENS"
+    rounds_name = "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_ROUND"
+    tokens, rounds = os.environ.get(tokens_name), os.environ.get(rounds_name)
+    if (tokens is None) != (rounds is None):
+        raise ValueError(f"{tokens_name} and {rounds_name} must be set together")
+    if tokens is not None:
+        if not all(
+            re.fullmatch(r"[ \t\n\r\v\f]*[+-]?[0-9]+", v) for v in (tokens, rounds)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"{tokens_name} and {rounds_name} must be integers")
+        per_round, round_count = int(tokens), int(rounds)
+        if not (32 <= per_round <= 8192 and 1 <= round_count <= 256):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{tokens_name} must be in [32, 8192] and {rounds_name} in [1, 256]"
+            )
+        if per_round * round_count > 131072:
+            raise ValueError(f"{tokens_name} * {rounds_name} must not exceed 131072")
+    else:
+        per_round = DEEPEP_PER_ROUND_TOKENS
+    combine_name = "DEEPEP_NORMAL_COMBINE_ENABLE_LONG_SEQ"
+    combine = os.environ.get(combine_name, "0")
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", combine) or int(combine) > 2147483647:
+        raise ValueError(f"{combine_name} must be a nonnegative 32-bit integer")
+    return per_round, tokens is not None, bool(int(combine))
+
+
+def initialize(server_args):
+    """Resolve automatic HCCL sizing before scheduler/HCCL initialization."""
+    # Snapshot overrides before the general heuristic fills HCCL_BUFFSIZE.
+    hccl = os.environ.get("HCCL_BUFFSIZE")
+    deepep = os.environ.get("DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE")
+    if hccl is not None:
+        logger.info("NPU autotune: HCCL_BUFFSIZE=%s MiB source=explicit", hccl)
+    if deepep is not None:
+        logger.info("NPU autotune: DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE=%s MiB source=explicit", deepep)
+    elif hccl is not None:
+        logger.info(
+            "NPU autotune: DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE=%s MiB source=inherited HCCL_BUFFSIZE",
+            hccl,
+        )
+    if hccl is not None:
+        return
+
+    context = context_from_server_args(server_args)
+    rows = representative_prefill_rows(context)
+    element = 4 if context.dtype in ("float32", "torch.float32") else 2
+    proposed = {"HCCL_BUFFSIZE": hccl_buffer_mb(rows, context.hidden_size, element)}
+    if deepep is None:
+        backend, mode = server_args.moe_a2a_backend, server_args.deepep_mode
+        if (
+            context.num_experts_per_tok
+            and backend == "deepep"
+            and context.ep_size > 1
+            and mode in ("normal", "auto")
+        ):
+            prt, ant_moving, combine = _deepep_round_config()
+            try:
+                proposed["DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE"] = deepep_normal_buffer_mb(
+                    rows,
+                    context.hidden_size,
+                    context.num_experts_per_tok,
+                    prt,
+                    ant_moving,
+                    combine,
+                )
+            except ValueError as exc:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"{exc} DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_ROUND="
+                    f"{os.environ.get('DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_ROUND', '1')}"
+                ) from exc
+        else:
+            logger.info(
+                "NPU autotune: DeepEP sizing skipped; not applicable: "
+                "topk=%s backend=%s ep=%s mode=%s",
+                context.num_experts_per_tok,
+                backend,
+                context.ep_size,
+                mode,
+            )
+    # Validation must finish before either value becomes visible to workers.
+    for name, value in proposed.items():
+        logger.info(
+            "NPU autotune: %s=%s MiB source=automatic rows=%s hidden=%s "
+            "dtype=%s tp=%s ep=%s",
+            name,
+            value,
+            rows,
+            context.hidden_size,
+            context.dtype,

+"""CPU-only HCCL sizing policy coverage; importing the runtime is unnecessary."""

+import ast
+import importlib.util
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import unittest
+from dataclasses import replace
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=1, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+    "npu_autotune_policy_test",
+    ROOT / "python/sglang/srt/hardware_backend/npu/autotune.py",
+)
+auto = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+sys.modules[SPEC.name] = auto
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(auto)
+
+
+def context():
+    return auto.NpuTuningContext(
+        hidden_size=6144,
+        num_experts_per_tok=8,
+        tp_size=4,
+        ep_size=4,
+        chunked_prefill_size=16384,
+        max_prefill_tokens=32768,
+        dtype="torch.bfloat16",
+    )
+
+
+class TestNpuAutotune(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_hccl_current_shape(self):
+        self.assertEqual(auto.hccl_buffer_mb(16384, 6144, 2), 256)
+
+    def test_representative_prefill_rows(self):
+        for chunk in (16384, -1, 0):
+            c = replace(context(), chunked_prefill_size=chunk, max_prefill_tokens=16384)
+            self.assertEqual(auto.representative_prefill_rows(c), 16384)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            auto.representative_prefill_rows(
+                replace(context(), chunked_prefill_size=8192)
+            ),
+            8192,
+        )
+        for chunk, maximum in ((16384, 0), (0, 0), (-1, -1)):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(chunk=chunk, maximum=maximum),
+                self.assertRaises(ValueError),
+            ):
+                auto.representative_prefill_rows(
+                    replace(
+                        context(),
+                        chunked_prefill_size=chunk,
+                        max_prefill_tokens=maximum,
+                    )
+                )
+
+    def test_hccl_rounding_and_clamping(self):
+        self.assertEqual(auto.hccl_buffer_mb(1, 1, 2), 64)
+        self.assertEqual(auto.hccl_buffer_mb(1 << 20, 6144, 2), 1024)
+        self.assertEqual(auto.hccl_buffer_mb(16384, 6144, 2, headroom=1), 192)
+        self.assertEqual(auto.hccl_buffer_mb(16385, 6144, 2, headroom=1), 224)
+
+    def test_hccl_rejects_bad_parameters(self):
+        for kw in (
+            {"headroom": 0.5},
+            {"headroom": float("nan")},
+            {"quantum_mb": 0},
+            {"max_mb": 32},
+        ):
+            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                auto.hccl_buffer_mb(16384, 6144, 2, **kw)
+
+    def test_deepep_normal_formula(self):
+        # Combine streaming off (default): the full sequence must fit with two
+        # tensors per expert: 2 * (106 + 16384*2*6144*8 / 2^20) + 20 = 3304.
+        self.assertEqual(auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(16384, 6144, 8), 3328)
+        # 2 * (106 + 96) + 20 = 424.
+        self.assertEqual(auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(1024, 6144, 8), 448)
+        # Combine streaming on: one 8192-token round, three tensors per expert:
+        # 2 * (106 + 1152) + 20 = 2536.
+        self.assertEqual(
+            auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(16384, 6144, 8, combine_long_seq=True), 2560
+        )
+        # A user-tuned round size is respected: 2 * (106 + 504) + 20 = 1240.
+        self.assertEqual(
+            auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(16384, 6144, 8, 3584, combine_long_seq=True),
+            1248,
+        )
+        # Ant-moving with combine streaming off takes the larger term.
+        self.assertEqual(
+            auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(16384, 6144, 8, 3584, ant_moving=True), 3328
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(16384, 6144, 8, ant_moving=True), 3328
+        )
+        # The documented floor dominates for tiny models.
+        self.assertEqual(auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(1, 512, 1), 256)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "required_MiB=3328 cap_MiB=256"):
+            auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(16384, 6144, 8, max_mb=256)
+
+    def test_deepep_rejects_bad_parameters(self):
+        for args, kw in (
+            ((16384, 6144, 0), {}),
+            ((16384, 6144, 8), {"quantum_mb": 0}),
+            ((16384, 6144, 8), {"max_mb": 100}),
+        ):
+            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(*args, **kw)
+
+    def initialize(self, ctx=None, **args):
+        config = SimpleNamespace(moe_a2a_backend="deepep", deepep_mode="auto")
+        config.__dict__.update(args)
+        with patch.object(
+            auto, "context_from_server_args", return_value=ctx or context()
+        ):
+            auto.initialize(config)
+
+    def test_default_initialization_and_worker_inheritance(self):
+        with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
+            self.initialize()
+            self.assertEqual(os.environ["HCCL_BUFFSIZE"], "256")
+            self.assertEqual(os.environ["DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE"], "3328")
+            output = subprocess.check_output(
+                [
+                    sys.executable,
+                    "-c",
+                    "import os; print(os.environ['HCCL_BUFFSIZE'], os.environ['DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE'])",
+                ],
+                text=True,
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(output.strip(), "256 3328")
+            # Inherited settings need no model inspection or recalculation.
+            with patch.object(
+                auto, "context_from_server_args", side_effect=AssertionError
+            ):
+                auto.initialize(None)
+
+    def test_explicit_hccl_skips_all_calculation(self):
+        for overrides in (
+            {"HCCL_BUFFSIZE": "1000"},
+            {"HCCL_BUFFSIZE": "1000", "DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE": "1200"},
+        ):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(overrides=overrides),
+                patch.dict(os.environ, overrides, clear=True),
+                patch.object(
+                    auto, "context_from_server_args", side_effect=AssertionError
+                ),
+                self.assertLogs(auto.logger, level="INFO") as logs,
+            ):
+                auto.initialize(None)
+                self.assertEqual(dict(os.environ), overrides)
+                self.assertIn("source=explicit", "\n".join(logs.output))
+                if "DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE" not in overrides:
+                    self.assertIn("source=inherited", "\n".join(logs.output))
+
+    def test_explicit_deepep_bypasses_overflow_and_transport_parsing(self):
+        with patch.dict(
+            os.environ,
+            {
+                "DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE": "8000",
+                "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_PER_ROUND_TOKENS": "invalid",
+            },
+            clear=True,
+        ):
+            self.initialize(
+                ctx=replace(context(), hidden_size=7168, chunked_prefill_size=32768)
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(os.environ["HCCL_BUFFSIZE"], "576")
+            self.assertEqual(os.environ["DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE"], "8000")
+
+    def test_deepep_ceiling_and_rounding(self):
+        self.assertEqual(auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(1, 512, 1), 256)
+        # raw = 4096 MiB; one extra row crosses the rounding boundary.
+        self.assertEqual(auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(1932, 524288, 1), 4096)
+        for rows, hidden, topk, expected in (
+            (1933, 524288, 1, "required_MiB=4128"),
+            (32768, 7168, 8, "required_MiB=7424"),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(rows=rows), self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, expected):
+                auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(rows, hidden, topk)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "required_MiB=3328 cap_MiB=3327"):
+            auto.deepep_normal_buffer_mb(16384, 6144, 8, max_mb=3327)
+
+    def test_failure_leaves_environment_unchanged(self):
+        with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "required_MiB=7424") as error:
+                self.initialize(
+                    ctx=replace(context(), hidden_size=7168, chunked_prefill_size=32768)
+                )
+            self.assertEqual(dict(os.environ), {})
+            for field in (
+                "rows=32768",
+                "hidden=7168",
+                "topk=8",
+                "per_round_tokens=8192",
+                "combine_long_seq=False",
+                "cap_MiB=4096",
+                "DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE",
+                "LONG_SEQ_ROUND=1",
+            ):
+                self.assertIn(field, str(error.exception))
+
+    def test_deepep_applicability(self):
+        for ctx, args in (
+            (replace(context(), num_experts_per_tok=None), {}),
+            (replace(context(), ep_size=1), {}),
+            (context(), {"moe_a2a_backend": "none"}),
+            (context(), {"moe_a2a_backend": "ascend_tp"}),
+            (context(), {"moe_a2a_backend": "deepep_v2"}),
+            (context(), {"deepep_mode": "low_latency"}),
+        ):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(ctx=ctx, args=args),
+                patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True),
+                self.assertLogs(auto.logger, level="INFO") as logs,
+            ):
+                self.initialize(ctx=ctx, **args)
+                self.assertEqual(os.environ["HCCL_BUFFSIZE"], "256")
+                self.assertNotIn("DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE", os.environ)
+                self.assertIn("not applicable", "\n".join(logs.output))
+        for mode in ("auto", "normal"):
+            with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
+                self.initialize(deepep_mode=mode)
+                self.assertEqual(os.environ["DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE"], "3328")
+
+    def test_dtype_payload(self):
+        for dtype, expected in (
+            ("torch.bfloat16", "256"),
+            ("float16", "256"),
+            ("torch.float16", "256"),
+            ("float32", "480"),
+            ("torch.float32", "480"),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(dtype=dtype), patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
+                self.initialize(
+                    ctx=replace(context(), dtype=dtype), moe_a2a_backend="none"
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(os.environ["HCCL_BUFFSIZE"], expected)
+
+    def test_transport_settings(self):
+        for extra, expected in (
+            ({"DEEPEP_NORMAL_COMBINE_ENABLE_LONG_SEQ": "1"}, "2560"),
+            (
+                {
+                    "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_PER_ROUND_TOKENS": "3584",
+                    "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_ROUND": "32",
+                    "DEEPEP_NORMAL_COMBINE_ENABLE_LONG_SEQ": "1",
+                },
+                "1248",
+            ),
+            (
+                {
+                    "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_PER_ROUND_TOKENS": "3584",
+                    "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_ROUND": "32",
+                },
+                "3328",
+            ),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(extra=extra), patch.dict(os.environ, extra, clear=True):
+                self.initialize()
+                self.assertEqual(os.environ["DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE"], expected)
+                for name, value in extra.items():
+                    self.assertEqual(os.environ[name], value)
+
+    def test_invalid_transport_settings(self):
+        tokens = "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_PER_ROUND_TOKENS"
+        rounds = "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_ROUND"
+        for extra in (
+            {tokens: "8192"},
+            {rounds: "1"},
+            *(
+                {tokens: t, rounds: r}
+                for t, r in (
+                    ("bad", "1"),
+                    ("31", "1"),
+                    ("8193", "1"),
+                    ("8192", "0"),
+                    ("32", "257"),
+                    ("8192", "17"),
+                    ("8192 ", "1"),
+                    ("8_192", "1"),
+                    ("", "1"),
+                )
+            ),
+            {"DEEPEP_NORMAL_COMBINE_ENABLE_LONG_SEQ": "true"},
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(extra=extra), patch.dict(os.environ, extra, clear=True):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                    self.initialize()
+                self.assertEqual(dict(os.environ), extra)
+
+    def test_startup_hook_precedes_workers_and_is_npu_only(self):
+        tree = ast.parse((ROOT / "python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/engine.py").read_text())
+        functions = {
+            node.name: node
+            for node in ast.walk(tree)
+            if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
+        }
+        launch = functions["_launch_subprocesses"]
+        calls = {
+            node.func.id: node.lineno
+            for node in ast.walk(launch)
+            if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
+        }
+        worker_lines = [
+            node.lineno
+            for node in ast.walk(launch)
+            if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
+            and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute)
+            and node.func.attr == "_launch_scheduler_processes"
+        ]
+        self.assertLess(calls["_set_envs_and_config"], min(worker_lines))
+        hook = functions["_set_envs_and_config"].body[1]
+        # Execute the real guarded hook without importing the engine runtime.
+        module = ast.Module(body=[hook], type_ignores=[])
+        with patch.dict(
+            sys.modules, {"sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.autotune": auto}
+        ):
+            for device in ("cpu", "cuda", "npu"):
+                with patch.object(auto, "initialize") as initialize:
+                    cfg = SimpleNamespace(device=device)
+                    exec(compile(module, "engine_npu_hook", "exec"), {"cfg": cfg})  # noqa: S102
+                    self.assertEqual(initialize.call_count, int(device == "npu"))
+
